market_outlook.short_term: Markets digest Fed hike with mixed reaction: stocks rally on 'higher-for-longer' clarity, bonds sell off, dollar strengthens. Yen weakens on BOJ split. Near-term volatility elevated from Turkey, crypto regulatory gaps, and AI regulation headlines. US retail resilience supports equities but inflation data remains the swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: One more Fed hike in 2026 implies peak rates near current levels; gradual easing possible in 2027. AI capex cycle continues but regulatory framework will shape valuations. EM rotation favors China/Vietnam over Turkey/India. Commodity complex supported by China stimulus and supply disruptions. Healthcare and infrastructure remain structural winners.
